## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Parikkhārahāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying Requisites: Analysis") is an analytical section of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 18). Bimala Charan Law characterizes the *Parikkhārahāra* of the *Netti* as a chapter based upon the *Paṭṭhāna*, which elucidates causal correlation while contributing to the systematic analytical exposition of teachings traditionally attributed to Mahākaccāyana [Law 1923].

**Sources**

- [Law 1923] Bimala Charan Law, Life and Work of Buddhaghosa (1923) — Discusses the doctrinal scope of the Parikkhārahāra and its relationship to the Paṭṭhāna and causal correlation.
